words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) opens the ayah as a denial of a quality belonging to the shade already named in 56:43, not as a new noun or an absolute-genus construction. The genitive follower keeps the first negation attached to {{ar:بَارِدٍ}} ({{tr:bāridin}}), so the reader has to carry the prior shade forward and watch its expected shelter-value be stripped. As the first half of a {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) ... {{ar:وَلَا}} ({{tr:wa-lā}}) frame, it launches a two-beat refusal: first bodily coolness, then qualitative worth. The bare opening particle also contrasts with the fused second unit, making this first denial sound like the frame-setter whose cadence will return.

words.prose: {{ar:بَارِدٍ}} ({{tr:bāridin}}) is the first denied attribute of the prior shade. Its genitive, indefinite adjective form keeps the coolness dependent on that shade, while the nominative variant shows the pressure point by making the denial more predicate-like. The local sense is not mere temperature: in a shade setting, the cool branch means relief, refreshment, and bodily quiet, and the accepted rest/stillness pressure deepens the loss without replacing the selected cooling sense. The wording therefore creates an anti-shade: a cover-like shelter is present, with the root's garment or mantle branch sharpening the image, but its defining cooling protection has failed. Because the root is rare and also appears in hail/cold and punishment-relief contexts (24:43; 78:24), its denial here is lexically marked, while the paired cadence with {{ar:كَرِيمٍ}} ({{tr:karīmin}}) moves the ayah from sensory deprivation toward denied worth.

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) is the hinge that keeps one shade-description frame intact while opening the second denial. It coordinates {{ar:كَرِيمٍ}} ({{tr:karīmin}}) with {{ar:بَارِدٍ}} ({{tr:bāridin}}), so the phrase denies two qualities of one shade rather than forming two unrelated clauses. Because it is immediately followed by another {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}), the conjunction carries nor-value: the first denial closes, then the second begins without collapsing into a synonym. Its bound form and liaison into {{ar:وَلَا}} ({{tr:wa-lā}}) make the turn audible as well as grammatical, carrying the refrain into the ayah's second half.

words.prose: The second {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) gives {{ar:كَرِيمٍ}} ({{tr:karīmin}}) its own negated value. It is joined to the prior denial through {{ar:وَلَا}} ({{tr:wa-lā}}), but the repeated particle prevents the ending from becoming an implied afterthought: after coolness is denied, worth, dignity, generosity, and pleasantness are denied too. That renewed polarity makes the final half a closing verdict, not just a continuation. The repetition also gives the short ayah a two-beat symmetry, so the ear hears separate exclusions across one coordinated frame.

words.prose: {{ar:كَرِيمٍ}} ({{tr:karīmin}}) closes the ayah as the second denied adjective of the same prior shade. Its genitive case keeps the final word dependent on the shade, while the nominative variant exposes how different the ending would feel as an independent verdict. The local sense is evaluative: the shade is not noble, generous, pleasant, dignified, or worthy, so after {{ar:بَارِدٍ}} ({{tr:bāridin}}) removes bodily relief, this word removes residual honor or value. The broader {{ar:ك ر م}} ({{tr:k-r-m}}) range also includes productive bounty and yield; in this shade context that pressure is narrowed into anti-yield, a cover that gives no benefit rather than a literal vine or land sense. As a faʿīl quality adjective, it denies an inherent quality of the shade, not an act of honoring by another agent. The same surah later uses the root positively for noble revelation (56:77), so this closing negation becomes a local negative pole: punishment-shade is anti-{{ar:كَرِيمٍ}} ({{tr:karīmin}}), while the surah can later recover the root as positive worth.

topics.reason: The local surface is genitive, but the reported nominative contrast is valid apparatus for explaining dependency versus predication.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The coordinated negation in لَا بَارِدٍ وَلَا كَرِيمٍ joins a thermal predicate to a value predicate.
baseline_models.mechanism: The first branch tests whether the referent cools; the second tests whether it gives any praiseworthy, generous benefit. Failure on both axes excludes relief that is merely apparent or nominal.

activation_trace.role: Cooling as the opposite of heat supplies the sensory test that the first negation fails.
Praiseworthy generosity supplies the beneficial-value test that the second negation fails.

changed_reading.before: The referent is neither cool nor noble.
changed_reading.after: The referent provides neither physical cooling nor any redeeming or generous benefit; the second negation closes the loophole of useless semblance.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: بَارِدٍ can activate settling and stillness after heat or motion, while كَرِيمٍ names honored treatment.
baseline_models.mechanism: The pair can deny both a bodily transition into rest and a social transition into dignified reception.

activation_trace.role: Stillness and fixation after heat or movement make cooling a transition into repose, here negated.
Honor and generosity make reception into dignity the parallel outcome, also negated.

changed_reading.before: No pleasant temperature and no honorable quality are present.
changed_reading.after: No process of settling into repose occurs, and no dignity compensates for that unrest.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The two focus roots each carry a climatic-life branch: cooling or cooling precipitation under ب ر د and good rain, soil, and growth under ك ر م.
baseline_models.mechanism: Their paired negation can withhold both climatic moderation and the fecundity normally produced by a generous environment.

activation_trace.role: Cooling, cooling water, and precipitation supply climatic moderation, which the focus denies.
Good rain, soil, and vegetation supply environmental fecundity, which the parallel negation denies.

changed_reading.after: The phrase sketches a climate that neither moderates heat nor converts moisture and ground into life.

context_deltas.mechanism: Cooling-associated direction, penetrating heat, blackness, and shade assemble an enclosure that has the form of shelter but performs the opposite function. The focus pair becomes a verdict on counterfeit refuge: it covers without cooling and therefore has no praiseworthy protective value.

activation_trace.role: Literal cooling is the failed function against which the surrounding shelter is tested.
Praiseworthy benefit is the second failed function, turning deficient shelter into anti-shelter.
The north-wind branch and what it cools raise a cooling expectation at the cohort's repeated directional label.
A hot penetrating wind reverses the expected cooling by carrying heat through the enclosure.
Blackness, coal, and smoke make the apparent shade a heat-bearing dark medium rather than refuge.
Shade as covering supplies the shelter-form whose function the focus negations audit.

structural_cues: 56:41-44 moves from the named cohort through hot wind and liquid into smoky shade, then ends with two coordinated negations.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies cooling-associated شمال, penetrating hot wind, black smoke, and covering shade; I infer that cover creates an expectation of refuge which the focus pair then cancels. A live alternative is the narrower reading that 56:44 only inventories two sensory defects.

changed_reading.before: The smoky shade is neither cool nor pleasant.
changed_reading.after: The environment is a counterfeit shelter: enclosure remains, but both cooling and protective beneficence have been reversed.

context_deltas.mechanism: Former expansive luxury is answered by an allotted meal and a prepared نُزُل explicitly situated in recompense. The negated كَرِيم turns from a generic value judgment into a hospitality judgment: provision is present, but welcome, honor, and gift-like generosity are inverted.

activation_trace.role: Honor and generosity define the hospitality quality explicitly absent from the focus referent.
A gift seeking return supplies a reciprocal-gift frame that later recompense darkly reverses.
Expansive luxury supplies the prior mode of reception whose ease is being reversed.
A food-share or edible provision supplies the meal component of the hostile reception.
Prepared guest provision makes hospitality the sequence's explicit closing frame.
Reckoning and recompense convert the prepared provision into an answering return rather than a generous gift.

structural_cues: 56:45 gives a former condition, while 56:52-56 supplies food, drink, and the closing label نُزُلُهُمْ on the day of recompense.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies former luxury, edible allotment, guest provision, and recompense; I infer a reversal from self-indulgent reception to punitive anti-hospitality and let negated كَرِيم name its missing honor. The live alternative is that كَرِيم merely means pleasant or useful.

changed_reading.before: The focus object has no noble or pleasant quality.
changed_reading.after: It belongs to a fully provisioned but inverted hospitality: a reception with meal and drink from which generosity, honor, and gift have been removed.

context_deltas.mechanism: Persistence leads through death's stillness to reactivation, fixed-time gathering, and thirst that never settles. Negated بَارِد therefore reaches beyond temperature: no terminal cooling, sleep-like cessation, or achieved equilibrium ends the sequence.

activation_trace.role: Stillness after heat or motion makes بارد an available image of achieved repose, here denied.
Persistence supplies the initial refusal to release or settle.
Death as stillness, extinction, sleep, or decay supplies an apparent terminal rest.
Arousing what was still reverses that apparent terminal rest into renewed motion.
A fixed temporal limit routes reactivation toward an appointed convergence rather than release.
Thirst that cannot be quenched supplies the final bodily form of equilibrium never reached.

structural_cues: 56:46-55 runs from persistence through death and raising to appointed gathering and unquenchable drinking.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies persistence, death-like stillness, arousal, a fixed time, and unquenched thirst; I infer that the denied settling branch of ب ر د recurs as a no-termination mechanism. The live alternative confines بارد to the heat of 56:42-43.

changed_reading.before: The focus denies a cool state within a hot scene.
changed_reading.after: The focus also denies termination: neither death nor consumption lets motion, heat, and need settle into repose.

context_deltas.mechanism: Eating, vessel-like filling, abdominal loading, aversive drinking, and unquenchable thirst form a failed regulatory loop. Material enters and fills the body but neither cools it nor benefits it; abundance of intake is severed from nourishment and satiation.

activation_trace.role: Cooling supplies the regulatory outcome that repeated intake never achieves.
Whatever is praiseworthy in its category supplies the benefit test that the food and drink fail.
An edible share or provision introduces intake that should nourish.
Filling until contents equal the vessel makes quantity and capacity, not benefit, the governing result.
The belly's condition of fullness or illness locates the failed process inside the body.
Water drunk with aversion makes drinking an imposed continuation rather than relief.
Severe thirst that does not quench proves that volume consumed never becomes regulation.

structural_cues: 56:52-55 chains eating, filling, drinking, and repeated drinking, yet ends by specifying an unquenchable mode.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies edible provision, vessel-level filling, abdominal condition, aversive water, and unquenched thirst; I infer a physiological feedback loop whose expected outputs are cooling and benefit. A live alternative reads the sequence only as escalating quantities of punishment.

changed_reading.before: The focus describes an unpleasant medium outside the body.
changed_reading.after: The focus predicts a system-wide failure: what surrounds and enters the body can fill it indefinitely without cooling, nourishing, or satisfying it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because حَمِيمٍ in 56:42 is most immediately hot liquid, not kinship; it remains packet-anchored through the ح م م intimacy branch, the repeated cohort label, and focus ك ر م as the dear or honored one. Render only as a secondary relational resonance, not as a replacement gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: كَرِيمٍ can denote the dear or honored person, so its negation can remove relational preciousness as well as pleasant quality.

activation_trace.role: The dear person whom one honors anchors the focus phrase in relational value.
Companionship and continued association supply the social grouping around the focus scene.
Intimate kinship latent in حميم lets a heat-word carry a displaced relation-image.

changed_reading.before: No pleasant or noble property belongs to the smoky environment.
changed_reading.after: As a contained echo, the scene also offers company without companionship and a حميم that burns instead of acting as a dear protective relation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it activates ب ر د as cloth and ك ر م as a vessel lid rather than their adjectival defaults; it remains anchored by both focus roots and by wrapping, canopy, filling, and interior branches in the packet. Render as a material analogy of enclosure, never as the lexical translation of 56:44.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus pair has material branches for patterned covering under ب ر د and a lid placed over a vessel under ك ر م.

activation_trace.role: Cloth and patterned covering make the first focus adjective latent as a protective layer.
A lid on a vessel makes the second focus adjective latent as a fitting protective closure.
Wrapping in cloth supplies an enclosing outer layer.
An overhead canopy supplies the geometry of a lid above the enclosed subject.
Filling to the measure of a vessel turns enclosure into saturated capacity.
The inside of a thing locates a second, bodily container nested within the outer canopy.

changed_reading.before: The referent lacks two favorable attributes.
changed_reading.after: As a material analogy, outer shade and inner belly become nested vessels that enclose and fill without functioning as protective cover or fitting lid.

strongest_changes: The paired negation audits a counterfeit shelter: cover is present, but cooling and protective benefit are absent.
The later meal, drink, and نُزُل recast كَرِيم as failed hospitality and punitive recompense.
Repeated intake without quenching turns the focus phrase into a physiological failure of regulation, not only a description of ambient heat.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah's brevity works as a two-axis diagnostic: ب ر د tests cooling, settling, and regulation, while ك ر م tests benefit, honor, fecundity, and hospitality. Context repeatedly preserves the form of a good thing—shade, provision, drinking, company—while reversing its function.
remaining_uncertainties: The no-repose model depends on carrying the stillness branch of ب ر د beyond immediate thermal contrast.
The reciprocal-gift branch of ك ر م sharpens recompense but is less direct than its honor and generosity branch.
Relational and nested-vessel readings should remain secondary echoes because their activating branches are materially farther from the surface syntax.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Neither thermal relief nor valued hospitality.** `ب ر د` **B001** supplies cold and cooling; `ك ر م` **B001** supplies nobility and generosity and **B010** a highly valued thing. The double negation diagnoses the preceding shade as failing both physical and social functions. **Abductive move:** I infer that genuine shelter should cool and honor its guest. **Reading change:** the line exposes the punitive scene as counterfeit hospitality.

2. **No settling after heat.** `ب ر د` **B002** supplies stillness and fixed settling after heat or motion. **Abductive move:** I infer that the negation denies even the transition by which heat normally subsides. **Reading change:** suffering has no cooling endpoint or settled respite.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The `قرآن كريم` of 56:77 produced an unexpected contrast: what is denied to punitive shelter is affirmed of the protected recitation as nobility and value.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **The double negation removes both physical relief and beneficial reception.** `ب ر د` (B001, coldness, cooling, and relief) is denied beside `ك ر م` (B001, praiseworthy excellence and generosity). Ayat 42–43 provide hot wind, hot water, and smoke-shade; ayat 45–49 identify prior indulgence, persistent wrongdoing, and denial. The packet supplies a thermal quality and a value-bearing quality in parallel; I infer that the cover fails not only to cool but to confer any good proper to shelter. The line closes every route by which “shade” might still be read favorably.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 56:77 calls the recitation `كَرِيمٌ`, revealing by positive contrast that the negated quality here is praiseworthy benefit and reception, not merely intensity or social prestige.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P3 Heat That Penetrates Shelter and Intake
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Heat defeats every ordinary boundary: it enters through the air, occupies the would-be shelter, fills the interior body, and converts drinking into further thirst.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Pores, jaw-space, throat channels, vessel capacity, absorbent sand, and diseased camels turn punishment into a continuous transport mechanism from atmosphere to interior.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: A canopy that conducts heat instead of refuge
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Encompassing hot wind enters through narrow openings beneath a black overhead cover that withholds both cooling and beneficent shelter.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: enclosure from all sides `quranic:root_000819:B001/m01`; penetrating hot wind `quranic:root_000743:B004/m01`; narrow bodily openings `quranic:root_000743:B001/m01`; black smoke and soot `quranic:root_000001:B001/m01`; overhead canopy `quranic:root_000966:B003/m01`; cooling and coldness `quranic:root_000103:B001/m01`; beneficent honor `quranic:root_001294:B001/m01`; sweat and heat exposure `quranic:root_000001:B004/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The scene reverses shelter's function. A cover still encloses, but its material is blackened heat; the wind is defined by its ability to pass through fine openings, and the missing coolness and generosity make the canopy an exposure chamber.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P1-P5 Directed Transmission from Disclosure to Arrival
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: What is sent becomes effective through a directed chain from source and disclosure through carrier, channel, marked route, and intended reception.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Oral publication and physical courier movement share one delivery architecture; the wish that unwelcome news be heard without reaching its subject isolates failed arrival as the reversal of successful transmission.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Scout, courier, and marked route
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A scout gathers intelligence, a dispatcher sends a messenger, the courier travels a road, and visible markers, standards, and a beacon guide the movement to its destination.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: scout or spy sent to gather news `quranic:root_001069:B005/m01`; dispatching a messenger or force toward a purpose `quranic:root_000129:B002/m01`; courier and postal movement along a road `quranic:root_000103:B004/m01`; road marker and distinguishing boundary `quranic:root_001040:B002/m01`; raised visible standard `quranic:root_000531:B011/m01`; beacon or landmark guiding the route `quranic:root_001564:B005/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Across P1, P3, P4, and P5, the bridge is a role progression: observer, dispatcher, carrier, route marker, and visible destination. The scene materializes resurrection's dispatch and the surah's transmission language as movement with an assigned end, not diffuse motion or a message without an addressee.

Gözü, bedeni veya iç organları serinletmek için kullanılan ilaç, içecek ya da su.
Buluttan donmuş taneler halinde düşen dolu ve bunu taşıyan bulut.
Soğuklukla ilişkilendirilen hazımsızlık, mide ağırlığı veya bedensel rahatsızlık.
Günün serin iki ucu ve sıcağın dindiği vakitte gelme ya da yola çıkma.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi gidip gelen askerî ulak düzenini, yol üzerindeki görevliyi veya ulağı, belirli yol menzilini, ulak göndermeyi, hızla yol almayı ve ölüm habercisi benzetmesini açıkça aynı dalda toplar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dalın çekirdeği yol üzerindeki düzenli gidiş geliş ve haber taşıma sistemidir; kuş kanadı, hız ve hastalık benzetmeleri bu çekirdeğe bağlı özel aktarımlardır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım ulak ve menzil düzenini çekirdekte tutar; gönderme eylemi, hız, kuş kanadı ve ölüm habercisi söz öbeklerini ayrı bağlamsal uzantılar olarak sınırlar.

concept_map.definition: Belirli bir yol üzerinde gidip gelen ulaklar, yerleşik görevliler ve menziller aracılığıyla haber ya da askerî ileti taşıyan düzen bu dalın çekirdeğidir. Ulağın kendisi, on iki millik yol dilimi, yöneticiye ulak gönderme, hızlı ilerleme, kuşun iki kanadı ve ölüm habercisi sayılan hastalık bu düzenin bağlama bağlı uzantılarıdır.

facets.statement: Belirli yol ve duraklar boyunca gidip gelen ulaklara dayalı haberleşme veya askerî ileti düzeni.
Bu düzende haber taşıyan ulak veya yol üzerindeki belirli yerde görev yapan kişi.
Ulak düzeninin bir durağı veya on iki millik yol dilimi.
Bir yöneticiye ulak göndermek.
Ulağın yoldaki hareketine benzetilerek hızla ilerlemek veya yol almak.
Kuşun yolda gidip gelen ulağa benzetilen iki kanadı.
Yüksek ateşli hastalığı ölümün ulağı ve önceden haber vereni sayan benzetme.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak ve toplu kanıt yol üzerindeki ulak, yol görevlisi ve gidip gelmeye dayalı haberleşme düzenini verir. On iki millik menzil, hızlı yol alma, kuş kanatları ve yüksek ateşli hastalığın ölüm habercisi sayılması kaynaklar arasında tekil ya da sınırlı uzantılar olarak dağılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, dalı hem kişide veya şeyde bulunan övgüye değer üstünlük hem de eli açıklık, bağışlayıcılık, ayıptan uzak durma ve başkasını onurlandırma alanı olarak kurar. Verilen dal çerçevesi bu geniş çekirdeği doğru biçimde karşılar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, kolye, üzüm, kap kapağı ve kalça kemiği gibi aynı kökten gelen bağımsız nesne adlarını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, genel nitelik çekirdeğini ayrı tutar; belirli söz kalıpları, eylemler ve özel kullanımlar bu çekirdeğin bağımlı gerçekleşmeleri olarak gösterilir.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişide, davranışta ya da şeyde kendi alanına göre bulunan övgüye değer üstünlük; insanda eli açıklık, bağışlayıcılık ve utanç verici olandan uzak durma biçiminde belirir. Başkasını onurlandırma ve ona küçültücü olmayan değerli bir yarar ulaştırma da bu anlam alanına girer.

facets.statement: Kişi, davranış veya şey kendi alanında üstün ve övgüye değer sayılır.
İnsandaki çekirdek görünüm eli açıklık, bol iyilik, bağışlayıcılık ve güzel huydur.
Başkasını onurlandırmak veya ona incitmeden değerli bir yarar sağlamak bu niteliğin eylemsel uzantısıdır.
Kişinin kendisini ayıp ve utanç verici işlerden uzak tutması, kendi değerini koruyan bir tutum olarak anlatılır.
Övgüye değer çocuklar dünyaya getirmek veya değerli bir bağ ya da varlık edinmek bu geniş niteliğin özel örnekleridir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, övgüye değer üstünlük ile eli açıklık ve güzel huy çekirdeğinde birleşir; bağışlama, ayıptan kaçınma ve başkasını onurlandırma bu çekirdeğin başlıca görünümleridir. Övgüye değer çocuklar sahibi olmak ile değerli bir bağ ya da varlık edinmek de kaynakta verilen özel örneklerdir.
